raw: The initial translation along Y did not resolve the interpenetration, and the error increased slightly to 172mm. Since the door is still misaligned and interpenetrating, the issue is likely not just positional but also rotational. Rotating the door around its hinge axis (Y) may realign it with the body. A small positive Y rotation will pivot the door outward to clear the body. I will try ROTATE(P0, Y, 5) to adjust its orientation.

The rotation worsened the error, indicating the issue is likely not rotational but positional. Since the door is interpenetrating the body, translating it along the X-axis (perpendicular to the hinge) may help align it flush. I will try TRANSLATE(P0, X, -0.03) to pull the door inward and correct the misalignment. This is a targeted adjustment to resolve the interpenetration.
